title: David Oldham (builder-investor) — Incorruptible resonates 'on a very deep level'
summary: David Oldham — builder and investor across multiple companies — endorses Incorruptible on LinkedIn, saying it confirms core beliefs he's had about business structures, investors, and building things that benefit customers first rather than 'create shareholder value' at any cost.
blockquote: I've been listening to the new book from Eric Ries called Incorruptible. I'm only partway through, but its message resonates with me on a very deep level. It confirms core beliefs I've had about business structures, investors, and building things that benefit customers first rather than 'create shareholder value' at any cost.
